crosswalks.label: Document Management Specialists
crosswalks.rationale: Document Management Specialists is a bounded occupational baseline for Knowledge Management Specialist; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Knowledge Management must preserve source/version/status so discoverability and stored consensus never silently become truth or canon.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make stored-knowledge-versus-truth, summary-versus-source and person-dependent continuity boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Knowledge Management Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
